symptom: i2cdetect shows only the general-call address 0x00 as present and nothing else, even with no device that should ACK 0x00. My sensor never responds at its real address.

gold.diagnosis: When only the general-call address 0x00 ACKs, SDA is stuck low (often shorted to GND or a sensor holding the line). The controller reads an ACK on every address because the line never rises. This is a wiring/hardware fault; STOP coding and check for an SDA-to-GND short or a powered-down device holding SDA low.
